title: reference_form.js lacks the form_draft.js N10 capability gate — a JS-enabled browser without fetch/FormData.forEach gets a dead answer form
detail: preventDefault() already ran when the missing API throws (no promise exists, .catch never fires) — the answer form is left dead, breaking the file's 'progressive enhancement ONLY' contract and the form_draft.js pattern T9.1 mandates.
recommended_fix: Add the form_draft.js N10 gate (typeof root.fetch === 'function' and FormData.forEach) before binding submit listeners, or move preventDefault() after capability checks so legacy browsers fall through to the native POST.
